sources.quote: 2x full-size magnetic thumbsticks (TMR) with capacitive touch

notes: Valve's Steam store page for the Steam Controller (the 2026 model; https://store.steampowered.com/sale/steamcontroller, whose tech-spec Q&A is embedded as escaped JSON in the page; quotes are the decoded English text with HTML entities unescaped and the no-break spaces read as spaces). SIZE: Valve prints «Steam Controller: 111mm x 159mm x 57mm» with NO axis labels, so dimensions_mm.states.body stays null under the brief's rule (do not assume axis order; secondary sources label it height x width x depth). Mass «Steam Controller: 292 g» (the Puck: 16 g, 50mm x 28mm x 9mm, not filed). Controls (the «Gamepad controls», «Thumbsticks» and «Trackpads» answers together are the complete list: «A B X Y buttons | D-pad | L & R analog triggers | L & R bumpers | View & Menu buttons | Steam & QAM buttons | 4x assignable grip buttons»; «2x full-size magnetic thumbsticks»; «2x 34.5mm square trackpads»): face_button 4, dpad 1, trigger 2, bumper 2, button 4 (View, Menu, Steam, QAM), rear_button 4 (the grip buttons on the back of the handles; slab-handheld vocabulary, see the DualSense Edge note), stick 2, touchpad 2. Ports: one USB-C connector (charging and tethered play) = usb_c 1; the «Steam Controller Puck charging interface» (contacts for the Puck dock) has no contract kind; no headphone jack is listed. wired=false (2.4 GHz via the Puck, or Bluetooth). host_console null: it is a PC/Steam Deck/Steam Machine controller with no single host console. released: not on the page, null. The 2015 Steam Controller is not filed.
